These do not assume the result and admit err=0,u=0 for all nonempty xs. /evaluation/verification.json reports build_and_scans_exit_code=0 and formal_gate_passed=true; verification.log reports a successful build with no placeholders or custom axioms.

assumptions_added: Explicit 0 <= u, the usual unit-roundoff condition.
All err l j, including unused indices, satisfy |err l j| <= u. This is stronger than bounding only executed operations, but unused errors can be set to zero.
Arithmetic is abstracted as exact real Tree.eval with relative errors; no-overflow/no-underflow is represented by applicability of that model rather than a concrete floating-point implementation.
missing_obligations: An occurrence-preserving permutation between all input leaves before and after each level/round.
A proof that the returned singleton tree has exactly the original input occurrences.
The final componentwise backward-error theorem for the original xs, transporting perturbations through the proven permutation.
